methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
This source scopes the UN Digital Library (Invenio) to Secretary-General output: SG/ symbols (`SG/SM/...` press releases, `SG/A/...` appointments) and reports of the Secretary-General. Because SG reports are also issued under the A/ and S/ series, the scope is expressed through the `SG/` symbol prefix and the Secretary-General as authoring entity rather than a single series subfield.

## Search
Endpoint `https://digitallibrary.un.org/search`, query in `p`, `of=recjson`. Default scope `191__a:"SG/"`; broaden to SG reports with `700__a:"Secretary-General"` or `710__a:"...Secretary-General"`. Combine with `year:` and subjects (`650__a`) via Boolean `AND`.

## Filters
Symbol scope is the SG/ prefix (pre-set). Interface language `ln`; sort via `sf`/`so`.

## Pagination
Offset-1: `jrec` (1-based first-record index), `rg` (page size); page N = `jrec=(N-1)*rg+1`.

## Download
PDFs at `/record/{recid}/files/{filename}`, preferring `-EN.pdf`.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Per-record MARC21 XML at `/record/{recid}/export/xm?` (WAF-safe): symbol 191, title 245, author 700/710, subjects 650, files 856.

## Limitations
SG output has no single series discriminator, so recall depends on the symbol/author query. The `/search` list endpoint is AWS-WAF-challenged (HTTP 202); `export/xm` and `files` record paths are WAF-safe, so enrichment and download are reliable while listing may need retries.
probeNotes: Derived from the verified ods-ga probe (same Invenio platform). SG scope uses the SG/ symbol prefix + Secretary-General author rather than a 191$b series (SG output spans SG/SM, SG/A and A//S/ reports). Download/enrich record paths confirmed WAF-safe on sibling ODS sources.
